svg.aria-label: A local-first VS Code extension that diffs code at the syntax-tree level as you work, scores whether a feature-sized milestone has been reached, and drafts a Conventional Commit from what actually changed. A Turborepo monorepo: a typed IPC contract, a local JSON-RPC service on SQLite, and a React 19 webview. Why it is interesting: Fully offline by default, with a heuristic engine and no API keys. OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama, and precise tree-sitter parsing, slot in behind clean interfaces, and keys stay in the OS keychain.
